title: event.acknowledge
description: Update events: close, acknowledge/unacknowledge, add a message, or change severity. Only trigger events (problem events) can be updated.

eventids.description: IDs of the events to acknowledge. Required.

action.description: Event update action(s). Possible bitmap values are: 1 - close problem; 4 - add message; 6 - acknowledge event; 8 - change severity; 16 - unacknowledge event. This is a bitmask field; any sum of possible bitmap values is acceptable (for example, 6 for acknowledge event and add message). Required.

message.description: Text of the message. Required, if action contains 'add message' flag.

severity.description: New severity for events. Required, if action contains 'change severity' flag. Possible values: 0 - not classified; 1 - information; 2 - warning; 3 - average; 4 - high; 5 - disaster.
